15 of 28 questions will not be answered by waiting.
15 of 28 questions will not be answered by waiting.
6 are answered from captures already held and 7 need the series to reach a stated length. The other 15 are open for a
different reason — no method, or no field in the source that could carry the answer. Waiting does not move them, so they are
drawn off the axis rather than at the end of it.
Read from this repo, not typed: questions and their status from the README table, cadence from registry/, first capture from
manifest/. A month is 30.44 days. THIS PLATE MEASURES NOTHING ABOUT THE WORLD — it is the capture plan drawn as a plan, and it is
wrong the moment the table says something the capture does not deliver.
